value.rationale: A published nonlinear fourth-order energy-dissipative integrator can have an entire spurious fixed line at a universal finite step even when the continuous strongly convex mechanical model has a unique global attractor. The exact quadratic slow-root constant measures critical slowing near that step; a natural stability property not characterized by formal order or nonincrease of energy. It provides a reproducible boundary for step selection.
